exposure: postoperative pain management for cesarean hysterectomy
outcome: successful outcomes for patients with PAS
cohort: The review discusses the care of patients with suspected placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who undergo cesarean hysterectomy.
finding: Anesthesiologists are critical members of the multidisciplinary team managing patients with suspected placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), providing essential peripartum care vital for achieving successful outcomes.
